name: Blackwood Valley

climate: Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and Semillon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the South West Australia area of Western Australia. Sauvignon Blanc (26 percent), Shiraz (22) and Cabernet Sauvignon (21) lead plantings, with Semillon at 14 percent.
